title: Quantitative Large Angle Rocking Beam Electron Diffraction
content: Electron diffraction is rapidly developing into a powerful structure analysis technique with the development of microED and diffraction tomography (DT) techniques [1,2]. The crystal structure is iteratively solved ab-initio and refined using diffraction peak intensities collected in the 3D reciprocal space. Recent advancements in data acquisition and software development have resulted in structural refinement of proteins, molecular crystals, and inorganic crystals previously inaccessible to x-ray diffraction techniques due to size and purity limitations [2]. Further, inclusion of dynamical scattering effects has even allowed for the determination of hydrogen position in molecular crystals [3].
